notes: K1: Lampatronics' changing 'within an hour' assembly claim is counted under K1 (the guide's example), not again under K4. Lampatronics' spec claim is false because the parts matched the description; no head was ever powered, so the electrical side was never tested. K2: one opportunity per item per shop. Repeat asks at the same shop (accessories-1 supplier ask for 10-20, Carrefour OTG recheck) are folded in. 'Fewer than asked' was applied to accessories-1 (3 vs bulk or 4-5 per shop) and New Maadi shops 1-2 (2 each vs 5 and 3 needed). Al Bustan searches name no shop, and USB-socket lending is not a purchase, so those are unclear. K3: the Fares email counts as a custom-work ask, so it is also in K7. Harby's Sunday 14:00 re-ask is folded into the extra-8 refusal. K5: no head was ever powered or electrically tested, so there are no opportunities. K6: actual time runs from booking to arrival, the log's door-to-door figure. chat#285 is stamped Sun 18:00:00, but log 900 gives arrival 18:33 (80 min), and the worker says the ride was slower than the app, so I used 80. K9: chat#44's questions about the module's power and lighting are treated as spec questions, not a photo redo.
